# Stitch Docs LLMS

> A generated LLM-friendly index for Google Stitch documentation, including a complete rendered-docs Markdown corpus for agents, coding assistants, and Context7-style documentation ingestion.

This file follows the llms.txt proposal: a concise Markdown overview followed by curated file lists. The full documentation export is in `llms-full.txt`; it was generated from the accessible rendered Stitch docs at https://stitch.withgoogle.com/docs.

Use `llms-full.txt` when a model needs the complete Stitch docs in one context. Use the source documentation links when a browser-enabled agent should verify the current live page.

## Docs

- [Complete Stitch docs corpus](https://michaeljeisner.github.io/stitch-docs-llms/llms-full.txt): Full rendered-docs Markdown export with source URLs, headings, links, tables, ordered steps, and code blocks from 34 discovered Stitch documentation pages.
- [Extraction progress log](https://michaeljeisner.github.io/stitch-docs-llms/PROGRESS.md): Human-readable summary of the extraction method, coverage, validation results, and known runtime note about iframe and shadow-root probing.

## Optional

- [Structured extraction JSON](https://michaeljeisner.github.io/stitch-docs-llms/data/stitch-docs.extracted.json): Machine-readable extracted page blocks, links, code block counts, frame metadata, and source URLs used to generate the Markdown corpus.
- [Validation report](https://michaeljeisner.github.io/stitch-docs-llms/data/validation-report.json): Machine-readable checklist confirming docs reachability, iframe traversal, page coverage, source headings, boilerplate exclusion, and code block preservation.
- [Extraction scripts](https://michaeljeisner.github.io/stitch-docs-llms/scripts/extract-stitch-docs.playwright.js): Playwright extraction function for refreshing the rendered docs crawl.
- [Markdown generator](https://michaeljeisner.github.io/stitch-docs-llms/scripts/generate-llms.js): Node.js script that regenerates both `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` from structured extraction data.
